0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000010_GOSSAN
0.description: Although we are gathered here for the same reason, we hail from different lands.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000020_GOSSAN
1.description: Some were born and raised in the Alexandria of old, while others came to us from Tuliyollal.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000030_GOSSAN
2.description: It was from this union of diverse peoples that a new Alexandria was born─the only home that our younger generation knows.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000040_GOSSAN
3.description: How did we overcome the barriers between us? What moved us to join hands in common purpose beneath crackling skies?

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000050_GOSSAN
4.description: You know the answer. We survived─we thrived─because Queen Sphene brought us together.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000060_GOSSAN
5.description: Inspired and encouraged by her boundless kindness, we strove to be better, for ourselves as well as those around us.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000070_GOSSAN
6.description: And in Her Majesty's absence...there is a sadness beyond words. Yet we must─we <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> remember her. Remember all the good that she has done for us.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000080_GOSSAN
7.description: So let us pray, as the people of the old kingdom once did, for the peaceful repose of the departed.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000090_GOSSAN
8.description: And let us keep our beloved queen forever in our hearts, that her memory might guide us unto the morrow.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000100_GOSSAN
9.description: Would that I could find solace in my own words...

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000110_ALEXANDRIABOY71
10.description: Was Queen Sphene taken to the cloud?

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000120_ALEXANDRIAMOTHER71
11.description: She must have been. To still remember her...is strange, isn't it, darling?

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000130_ALEXANDRIABOY71
12.description: I miss her. She would always cheer me up when I was down.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000140_ALEXANDRIABOY71
13.description: But even though I remember her, I'll never see her again? That doesn't make sense!

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000150_ALEXANDRIAMOTHER71
14.description: It seems that's what it means to die, I'm afraid.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000160_ALEXANDRIABOY71
15.description: But...but what will happen to us? Are we just going to be sad forever?

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000180_ALEXANDRIAMAN71A
17.description: Everything that we have, we owe to Queen Sphene. How are we to go on without her?

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000190_ALEXANDRIAWOMAN71A
18.description: I still remember Her Majesty so clearly... If only I didn't, I might feel better about the future of our realm.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000200_ALEXANDRIAMAN71A
19.description: Perhaps we should also consider moving to Tuliyollal. The journey won't be easy, but it'd be better than staying here in uncertainty.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000210_WUKLAMAT
20.description: In times like these, I take comfort in the beliefs of a Turali people called the Yok Huy.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000220_WUKLAMAT
21.description: To them, death isn't the end. So long as we're remembered, we never truly die.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000230_WUKLAMAT
22.description: It could be the same for Queen Sphene, you know? If you keep her alive in your hearts, she'll always be with you.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000240_ALEXANDRIABOY71
23.description: But...we still won't be able to see her, right? I don't want to think about that...

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000250_ALEXANDRIABOY71
24.description: I wish I could just forget instead of having to feel like this...

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000260_WUKLAMAT
25.description: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to impose... Please, mourn your queen however you see fit.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000270_WUKLAMAT
26.description: As expected, they struggle to come to terms with their loss. I hope they can find a way to move forward.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000280_KRILE
27.description: It's not only grief that weighs on them, but worry for the future. Bereft of their queen, how will they proceed...

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000290_WUKLAMAT
28.description: True... But with that, at least, we're not powerless to help.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000310_GULOOLJA
30.description: I was wondering... Is it better to remember or forget someone when they're dead?

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000320_GULOOLJA
31.description: I remember my father. And every time I think of him, it hurts.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000330_GULOOLJA
32.description: It's the same with Queen Sphene. Knowing that she's gone makes me feel sad.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000340_GULOOLJA
33.description: But it's different with my mother. I never knew her, so I don't feel as bad.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000350_GULOOLJA
34.description: I want to remember my father. But maybe I'd be better off forgetting him...

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000370_KRILE
36.description: Why don't we continue this somewhere else?

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000380_WUKLAMAT
37.description: For all the talk of my brother felling this beast, he only imprisoned it, like Valigarmanda.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000390_KRILE
38.description: From what I could tell, they sought to transfer people's souls and memories into bestial vessels at that facility.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000400_KRILE
39.description: The tural vidraal explains the need for a remote location. It was doubtless their prime subject.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000410_KRILE
40.description: Though I expect Zoraal Ja did not foresee the opportunities it presented when he imprisoned the creature...

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000420_KANILOKKA
41.description: ...And so, in order to prevent the breakdown of the individual, I instead seek to transfer their soul into the body of the beast.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000430_ZORAALJA
42.description: This would allow one to wield the power of a tural vidraal?

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000440_KANILOKKA
43.description: In theory. Our initial experiments will involve lesser creatures, but in time I am confident we will be able to bring even the mightiest under our control.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000450_ZORAALJA
44.description: And what becomes of those who offer their souls?

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000460_KANILOKKA
45.description: As they won't be able to return to their original forms, we must consider them lost. But the sacrifice will be worthwhile, for the army you stand to gain will far surpass any composed of mechanical soldiers.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000470_ZORAALJA
47.description: Very well. Recruit volunteers and begin at once.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000480_KANILOKKA
48.description: Thank you, Your Majesty. I shall return to the observatory and see to the necessary preparations.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000490_TEESHALJA
49.description: (-Mamool Ja Woman-)So you've given him permission.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000500_ZORAALJA
50.description: Teeshal Ja. You will assist Kanilokka.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000510_ZORAALJA
51.description: As one of the Landsguard's finest chirurgeons, your knowledge may be of use in his experiments.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000520_ZORAALJA
52.description: You will also watch him. Closely. And what you learn, you will report to me.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000530_ZORAALJA
53.description: You object to his project? Or are you incapable of performing this duty?

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000550_TEESHALJA
55.description: Whether we shelter within the dome or expand beyond it, we require great power.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000560_TEESHALJA
56.description: But with no one to rely upon, we must take that power for ourselves. Even if the means are questionable.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000570_TEESHALJA
57.description: I will do as you command.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000580_TEESHALJA
58.description: But if Kanilokka's work bears fruit, I wish to beg a boon.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000600_TEESHALJA
60.description: Something that I had accepted I would never have in Tuliyollal.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000610_TEESHALJA
61.description: That I believed would forever be beyond me─that it was foolish to covet...

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000620_TEESHALJA
62.description: But here─here and now, it is close...

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000640_ZORAALJA
64.description: Perform your duty to my satisfaction, and anything you desire is yours.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000650_ZORAALJA
65.description: That which I seek does not lie within this dome. Here, I cannot prove the miracle.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000660_ZORAALJA
66.description: But if what <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> seek is at hand, then you may claim it. For it has no value to me.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000680_GULOOLJA
68.description: Teeshal Ja... Could she be my mother?

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000690_WUKLAMAT
69.description: Like the people in the outskirts said, few Mamool Ja lived in Yyasulani. I can't imagine many other Hoobigo women were trapped in the dome.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000700_WUKLAMAT
70.description: That being the case, she could well be the one.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000710_KRILE
71.description: This observatory Kanilokka returned to─could it not be part of the research facility? We might learn something about Teeshal Ja there.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000720_WUKLAMAT
72.description: That's where we're going next, then.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000740_HHETSARROMAN
74.description: A tturuhhetso is coming this way!

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000750_HHETSARROMAN
75.description: It has beasts across the plains in a panic─and our rroneek are practically paralyzed with fear. We must get them to safety!

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000760_ERENVILLE
76.description: We can assist by helping to calm the creatures. Once they're less agitated, it should be possible to herd them.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000770_WUKLAMAT
77.description: And after they're out of harm's way, we'll deal with the rroneek reaver!

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000780_KOANA
78.description: I suggest you remain here to attend to the rroneek when they arrive.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000790_HHWATO
79.description: They'll be safe with me. Please be careful out there.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000800_WUKLAMAT
80.description: Look there! We've got a big one coming!

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000820_ERENVILLE
82.description: That's a rroneek reaver, and no mistake.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000870_KOANA
87.description: Even should it cost me my life...

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000910_KOANA
91.description: Do not concern yourself with me. Get the rroneek to safety!

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000920_ERENVILLE
92.description: There, there. You've nothing to fear.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000940_KOANA
94.description: I made a vow to our people. You shall plague them no longer!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000970_ERENVILLE
97.description: The rroneek have all made it to Mehwahhetsoan. Hunters are scouring the area for any remaining threats, but the local fauna appear to have calmed down.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000980_HHWATO
98.description: We cannot thank you enough for your timely aid.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_000990_HHWATO
99.description: You most of all, Vow of Reason.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001000_HHWATO
100.description: We feared you would be loath to take direct action, yet you didn't hesitate to put your life on the line for our hhetso.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001010_KOANA
101.description: I did no more than is a Dawnservant's duty.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001020_KOANA
102.description: The aetherial conductivity of those scales is astounding. I daresay we could repurpose them to create a device that emits controlled pulses of aether.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001030_ERENVILLE
103.description: ...Aether resembling that of the predator the rroneek fear most.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001040_ERENVILLE
104.description: It might work. If we struck the right balance, we would have the means to deter the rroneek from approaching the railroad without causing them undue distress.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001050_WUKLAMAT
105.description: Incredible! Koana, you've done it again!

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001060_HHETSARROMAN
106.description: I must say, I was hoping I'd never have to see one of these again...

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001070_HHETSARROMAN
107.description: Still haven't forgotten the last one─and it's been more than twenty years now.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001080_HHETSARROMAN
108.description: I had come as a trader to the camp in Loazeniheta. A camp that was obliterated in an instant by that monster.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001090_KOANA
109.description: Loazeniheta? That's where the Pelupelu trader found me as a babe...

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001100_KOANA
110.description: Please, can you tell me what you saw?

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001110_HHETSARROMAN
111.description: As I said, I had traveled there to trade with our fellow Hhetsarro.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001120_HHETSARROMAN
112.description: Like us, they followed the rroneek. And like us, they were visited by a reaver.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001130_HHETSARROMAN
113.description: The fiend struck like a whirlwind in the night. It was chaos.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001140_HHETSARROMAN
114.description: I grabbed some token belongings and bolted in a panic, thinking only of getting as far away as possible. But even in my panicked state, I could not help but notice the young couple racing the other way─toward the fell creature!

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001150_HHETSARROMAN
115.description: "We'll distract it!“ I heard one cry. ”Save our son! Save the hhetso!“

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001160_HHETSARROMAN
116.description: After that, nothing but the pounding of my heart and feet and rroneek thunder. I ran and ran...and as the sun broke the horizon, I found myself separated from both man and beast.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001170_HHETSARROMAN
117.description: Windborne words say that a group of survivors reunited with their remaining rroneek, and have long since moved on.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001180_HHETSARROMAN
118.description: But still more were never seen again, including the brave couple...or so the story goes.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001200_HHETSARROMAN
120.description: I'm afraid I don't know. But if he wasn't with the survivors, even if he lived through that night... The wilderness wouldn't have been kind to a little one out on his lonesome.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001210_KOANA
121.description: Maybe not...but perhaps a passing Pelupelu would. And, one day, even the Dawnservant himself...

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001220_KOANA
122.description: All these years, I was convinced that my parents had left me behind to follow after the rroneek.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001230_KOANA
123.description: But now I see. They didn't abandon me─they were trying to keep me safe.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001240_KOANA
124.description: I've wasted so much time resenting them, when in truth they gave me everything I have today.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001250_KOANA
125.description: It is thanks to them that I lived to know the warmth of family, even after they were gone.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001260_KOANA
126.description: And now that I am Dawnservant, all of Tuliyollal is my family.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001270_KOANA
127.description: A family I will always protect...as my parents protected me.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001290_WUKLAMAT
129.description: Whoa! She looks as good as new!

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001300_WAWLIKA
130.description: If I had time to do a proper job, I could've really made her shine.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001310_WAWLIKA
131.description: Had to cobble together the exterior with spare parts. We refurbished the interior, though─not that you can appreciate it from out here.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001320_WAWLIKA
132.description: But as far as the rroneek are concerned, we've spared no effort.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001330_WAWLIKA
133.description: From the ballast to the ties, we've adjusted every bit of the track so she'll run quiet as a field mouse.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001340_KOANA
134.description: You and your crew have worked wonders. Our nation is in your debt.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001350_WAWLIKA
135.description: Come now─if anything, credit's due to Tuliyollal! It's thanks to the folk you recruited from every corner of the continent that we were able to get her up and running so quickly.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001360_WAWLIKA
136.description: Besides, the aetherial whistle's the true marvel, and we wouldn't have that without the scales you brought us.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001370_WAWLIKA
137.description: However grateful you are, know that we're even more thankful.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001380_NITOWIKWE
138.description: Right! If we're done talking, let's put this train through her paces!

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001410_NITOWIKWE
141.description: On it! Just point it in the general direction and...

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001430_ERENVILLE
143.description: Meanwhile, our friends over there appear wholly unperturbed.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001440_KOANA
144.description: With this, we can alert those who wander too close without disturbing the rest of the herd.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001450_NITOWIKWE
145.description: A roaring success! ...In a quiet way, like.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001460_NITOWIKWE
146.description: Then with your permission, Vow of Reason... The Xak Tural railroad is back in service!

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001470_SHALE
147.description: There was a mountain of data to sift through─much of it tantalizing, I admit.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001480_SHALE
148.description: But it will take time to fully decrypt everything that piques my interest, so to answer our immediate question, I've been concentrating my efforts on the audio saved by Teeshal Ja herself.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001490_SHALE
149.description: While I've not listened to it yet, I have a selection ready for playback. Would you like to hear it now?

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001510_SHALE
151.description: All right. Several audio files will now play in sequence.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001520_TEESHALJA
152.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)...I, er... Ahem. My name is Teeshal Ja, and I've decided to record this to...to help me put my thoughts in order, I suppose.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001540_TEESHALJA
154.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)Officially, I am─was?─a chirurgeon with the Landsguard. I was part of a contingent dispatched to Yyasulani to hunt a tural vidraal that was wreaking havoc.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001550_TEESHALJA
155.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)After our mission was complete, I elected to remain. It was the perfect opportunity to document the geographic distribution of medicinal herbs in this region.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001560_TEESHALJA
156.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)...Or so I said when requesting special dispensation. In truth...I could not bear to return to Tuliyollal.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001570_TEESHALJA
157.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)I had hoped to aid Commander Zoraal Ja in the rite of succession, but he did not so much as look my way. I was never in contention, of course─one of the nameless many in his army...

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001580_TEESHALJA
158.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)To go back and face that reality was too much for me, so I ran. And in my cowardice, I stumbled upon this path. A path that changed my life.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001590_TEESHALJA
159.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)When the dome appeared, I found myself trapped within...and reunited with my commander.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001600_TEESHALJA
160.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)I... How am I to speak of Commander Zoraal Ja?

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001605_TEESHALJA
161.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)I admired him. His incontestable strength. His unwavering focus. He was...a man of great passions.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001610_TEESHALJA
162.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)I watched him, captivated by his intensity. From afar─I would not dare approach. And in watching, I came to know him.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001620_TEESHALJA
163.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)His eyes, too, sought the distance─but not as mine did. He yearned not for another, but something else, beyond the horizon.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001630_TEESHALJA
164.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)That gaze would never fall upon me, I knew. I knew...

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001640_TEESHALJA
165.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)The experiment will soon proceed to its next phase. And when it does, as he promised...

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001650_TEESHALJA
166.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)I will have my heart's desire.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001670_TEESHALJA
168.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)It should have been today. A new beginning. What I have dreamed of for so long...

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001680_TEESHALJA
169.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)I hold a future in my arms. If he could see him─embrace him... Surely, surely, that would be enough...

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001690_TEESHALJA
170.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)So full of hope I was. A foolish hope...

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001750_ZORAALJA
176.description: I...I-I don't know how─how could I...? How!?

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001760_ZORAALJA
177.description: To raise a child─be a fa-father...

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001780_ZORAALJA
179.description: No... No! Get it away from me...

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001785_ZORAALJA
180.description: Get that thing away from me!

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001790_TEESHALJA
181.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)Shhh... It's all right, little one. Papa was just surprised, that's all.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001800_TEESHALJA
182.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)He'll come around. We'll be a happy family.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001810_TEESHALJA
183.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)...Kanilokka's shouting for me. The research hasn't been going well...but I can't let him take it out on my baby.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001820_TEESHALJA
184.description: (-Teeshal Ja-)Hush now, little one. I know... I know just where to hide you...

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001840_CAHCIUA
186.description: (-Cahciua-)He was abandoned, the poor dear. We found him in the driftdowns a few years ago.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001850_SHALE
187.description: We know some manner of accident happened at the facility after this was recorded. Perhaps your mother couldn't come back for you.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001880_GULOOLJA
190.description: Father and Mother, they were both so lonely...

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001890_GULOOLJA
191.description: If we could've been together, maybe they wouldn't have been. But sometimes things don't work out, no matter how hard you try.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001900_GULOOLJA
192.description: I...I can't tell if I'm happier now...

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001910_GULOOLJA
193.description: ...But it's better to know, I think. Thank you, everyone.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001920_WUKLAMAT
194.description: The people look uneasy. Did something happen?

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001930_ALEXANDRIAMAN71A
195.description: (-Unsettled Mourner-)Have you heard? Someone was killed in the Thunderyards.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001940_ALEXANDRIAWOMAN71B
196.description: The Thunderyards? Was one of the hunters slain by a beast?

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001950_ALEXANDRIAMAN71A
197.description: (-Unsettled Mourner-)It was a hunter all right, and a veteran at that. But it was no fiend that did him in─only a random bolt of lightning.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001960_ALEXANDRIAWOMAN71A
198.description: Such a senseless way to die. They say that he expended his last soul cells during Zoraal Ja's attack on the city...

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001970_ALEXANDRIAMAN71A
199.description: (-Unsettled Mourner-)For an upright, hardworking man to meet such an unceremonious end... It feels wrong...

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001980_ALEXANDRIAMAN71B
200.description: But we'll be fine, won't we? Even if the system no longer erases our memory of the departed, the regulators continue to function!

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_001990_ALEXANDRIAMAN71B
201.description: I shan't go before my time. Growing old and passing peacefully with the help of the ushers is only natural!

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002000_ALEXANDRIAWOMAN71B
202.description: You may think so, but how are we to know? We have no memory of those who have gone. More may have met violent deaths than passed from old age, and we would be blissfully unaware!

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002010_ALEXANDRIAWOMAN71B
203.description: It could happen to you or me─to any of us!

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002020_ALEXANDRIAMOTHER71
204.description: Then what are we to do? Spend every waking moment thinking only of how we might die?

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002030_WUKLAMAT
205.description: With time, I had hoped that they'd be able to adjust to their new situation...but it's only gotten worse.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002060_ALEXANDRIABOY71
208.description: Help, Queen Sphene! The grown-ups are really upset, and I don't know what to do!

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002070_NEWSPHENE
209.description: I see that you are as kind-hearted as ever, Nico. Never fear─I'm here to set things aright!

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002080_WUKLAMAT
210.description: I don't understand. Sphene is gone...forever...

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002090_WUKLAMAT
211.description: You there, Gossan! You were the queen's aide, weren't you?

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002110_GOSSAN
213.description: Begging your pardon, Vow of Resolve...

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002120_GOSSAN
214.description: But Her Majesty Queen Sphene is paying visit to her people, as is her wont.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002140_WUKLAMAT
216.description: Sphene is dead! You officiated the funeral yourself!

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002150_WUKLAMAT
217.description: We all placed flowers to mourn her passing!

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002170_GOSSAN
219.description: What a curious jest. You know full well that ceremony was to commemorate those lives lost during the attack of Alexandria.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002180_GOSSAN
220.description: Her Majesty walks among her people that she might support them in this most trying of times. Surely that is not cause for consternation?

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002200_ALEXANDRIAMOTHER71
222.description: Your Majesty, won't you free us from these terrible memories of the departed?

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002210_ALEXANDRIAMOTHER71
223.description: This is no way to live─not for us nor our children...

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002220_NEWSPHENE
224.description: ...I wish that I could. Truly, I do. But with Living Memory shut down, even I cannot restore the system that once afforded us that comfort.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002230_NEWSPHENE
225.description: You needn't fret, however. I have prepared an alternate solution.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002240_NEWSPHENE
226.description: All of us shall be made Endless!

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002250_NEWSPHENE
227.description: I have created a new system that allows you to transplant your memories directly into an aetherial vessel─one not reliant upon soul cells.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002260_NEWSPHENE
228.description: This way, you need never again fear death. You may live as you please─and for as long as you like!

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002270_NEWSPHENE
229.description: Our stores of aether are, at present, not sufficient to provide this boon to everyone...

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002280_NEWSPHENE
230.description: But some of you received neo regulators for the funeral ceremony, did you not?

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002290_NEWSPHENE
231.description: And there are still more we have yet to distribute. Five thousand in all!

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002300_NEWSPHENE
232.description: One day soon, those with neo regulators will be called to join the Endless, and thence be free of suffering forevermore!

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002330_WUKLAMAT
235.description: The real Sphene would never be content to save only some of her people!

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002350_NEWSPHENE
237.description: I am Sphene, the Queen of Reason.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07100_002370_WUKLAMAT
239.description: Let's return to the Backroom. I need to calm down...and then we'll talk.
